My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
Articles addressed to the Ed of [M P](../others.html#52) go to [Miss Coleridge](../persons.html#329).[^1] She has been from home and things go to arrears, which she has hardly made up yet, but I will tell her to see about your paper.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Joint editorship of the MP began in July 1891. CMY retired from the editorship in December 1893.
